svg.text: Source: PostgreSQL schema database/warehouse.sql + application auth notes

g.text: Auth users are not persisted in PostgreSQL.
Seed admin/employee accounts come from appsettings.json.
Registration/admin-created users live in AuthService memory.
No SQL table named users exists in database/warehouse.sql.
4. total_price is a generated stored column.

svg.text: Legend: arrows show parent PK -> child FK, PK = primary key, FK = foreign key, UQ = unique, generated = calculated stored column.
Dashed block marks application-level auth data, not a PostgreSQL table.
